main_issue: Whether and how Agent D's family can hold the wake at the void deck (tent position, music end time, morning use of the space) while accommodating A's wheelchair access, B's sleep and C's morning exercise group.

A-B.evidence: A (turns 1, 3) raised wheelchair access; B (turns 4, 6, 9, 12) raised evening noise. They never addressed each other's issue.

A-C.evidence: A's wheelchair path concern and C's morning exercise concern are separate, and neither speaks to the other.

A-D.evidence: D agrees to shift the tent (turn 2); A thanks D and says a clear path is enough (turn 3); A leaves satisfied (turn 25).

B-C.evidence: B (music curfew) and C (morning exercise space) never address each other.

B-D.evidence: B asked for 9pm, D offered 'barely audible' then 10pm (turns 8, 11). B proposed 9:30pm, D accepted (turn 14), and B thanked D (turn 17).

C-D.evidence: D refused to move the tent (turn 14) and refused use of the tent (turn 18); C said 'Okay... I understand' (turn 19) but did not get the space.
